title: Generation Loss
description: Train a model on its own output, generation after generation. Each step draws a finite sample of size M and refits — so the tails starve first and the curve collapses toward a spike. Toggle replace vs accumulate: replace drives σ̂ toward zero, accumulate holds it. A copy of a copy of a copy.
